attributes.action: Make this government pay for breach of duty of care for Uk citizens
attributes.additional_details:
It is time we hold this government responsible for their actions .
They have failed every uk citizen and much worse they have completely failed in their duty of care to all our women and children. 
This now has to stop and the Uk needs to stand together and fight back.
Any monies go to all the victims
attributes.background: I want the uk government to stand up and comply with their obligations to Uk citizens and the duty of care for Uk citizens and protect the women and children
